known_anomalies: one 2025 roster record (cortc001, Carlos Cortes, ATH, OF) carries throws = 'B'; he never appears at fielding position 1 in the 2025 files, so the anomaly touches no plate appearance; a build that consumes pitcher handedness should still refuse or declare a treatment for a non-L/R throws value
2024 contains 2,429 games, not 2,430 (one regular-season game not played); this is the same count the PR #2856 derivation parsed
parsing_rules: play records with event exactly 'NP' are substitution markers, not plays: skip (no plate appearance occurs)

a play record completes the batter's PA unless every segment of its primary event is baserunning-only (POCS/CS/SB/PO/PB/WP/BK/DI/OA/NP/FLE with digit or H base designators; error parentheticals may be truncated by the '/' modifier split)
pitcher of record for a PA = the fielding team's current position-1 player under start/sub defensive state
switch hitter (ROS bats = B) bats from the side opposite the pitcher of record's throwing hand

schema.handedness_fields: roster .ROS records: player_id, last, first, bats (L/R/B), throws (L/R), team, position. Switch hitters carry bats = B and are resolved per PA to the side opposite the pitcher of record's throwing hand (declared convention)
schema.lineup_fields: start/sub records: player_id, name, team (0=visitor, 1=home), batting slot (1-9; 0 = pitcher under the DH), fielding position (1 = pitcher, 10 = DH)
schema.pa_fields: play records: inning, batting team, batter player_id, balls-strikes count, pitch sequence, event string. The pitcher is not a play-record field: he is the fielding team's player at position 1 under start/sub defensive state (the standard Chadwick derivation)
schema.per_season_contents: 61 files per zip: 30 event files ({season}{TEAM}.EVA/.EVN, e.g. 2025ANA.EVA), 30 roster files ({TEAM}{season}.ROS, e.g. ANA2025.ROS), 1 TEAM{season} file; identical inventory 2022-2025
schema.record_type_note: 2025 adds 4 padj records (pitching adjustment) in 2,430 games; no record type is lost or changed in any season
schema.umpire_field: info,umphome,<retrosheet_person_id> in every game's info block (ump1b/ump2b/ump3b also present)
